changes_made.explanation: All extracted metadata for Q1 is correct and properly normalized. The paper clearly addresses code generation as an NLG task.
Normalized all pass@k variants to 'pass@k' as per simplification rules. The paper uses automatic metrics including pass@k for code quality and AUROC/TPR/FPR for detection performance.
The paper does not use LLMs as judges/evaluators. LLMs are used for generation (StarCoder, LLaMA2) but not for post-hoc evaluation of outputs.
No human evaluation is conducted in this paper. All evaluations are automated using code execution (pass@k) and statistical detection metrics (AUROC, TPR, FPR).

overall_notes: The extraction quality is generally good. Paper focuses on watermarking for code generation with strong emphasis on automated evaluation through code execution correctness (pass@k) and detection performance (AUROC/TPR/FPR). No human or LLM-as-judge evaluations are performed.
